tests.title: Web POS deducts the fixed amount when a code meets its spending requirement
tests.goal: Verify that the discount is a fixed amount on an above-cutoff cart.
preconditions: An active fixed-amount minimum-spend code applies to this store. Turn off unrelated discounts in the test cart.
data: Example: Gifted deducts HKD 23 over HKD 200. Use eligible products.

steps.text: Open a participating store in Web POS.
Build a basket with an eligible subtotal above the threshold.
Enter and apply the fixed-amount promotion code.
Clear the test cart without checkout.

expected.text: The cart shows the promotion and deducts the configured fixed amount. A HKD 249 cart with a HKD 23 offer totals HKD 226.

notes: Gifted deducted a fixed HKD 23 from HKD 249, total HKD 226.

tests.title: Web POS enforces the advertised cutoff for a fixed-amount minimum-spend code
tests.goal: Verify that neither a below-cutoff basket nor one exactly at the cutoff receives an offer described as over the cutoff.
preconditions: An active fixed-amount minimum-spend code applies to this store. Turn off unrelated discounts in the test cart.
data: Example: Gifted deducts HKD 23 over HKD 200. Use eligible products.

steps.text: Open a participating store in Web POS.
Apply the code to an eligible basket below the cutoff.
Remove the code and bring the eligible subtotal to exactly the cutoff.
Clear the test cart without checkout.

expected.text: No discount applies below the cutoff.
No discount applies at the exact cutoff under the advertised wording.

notes: HKD 100 gave no discount although marked Applied. Exactly HKD 200 received the HKD 23 discount despite over wording. See Q-025.
